notes:
• New: Watch provider (Settings › Accounts): ValFlix on this device, Trakt, Simkl, MDBList or PunchPlay drives check marks, resume points, Next Episode and your rows
• Link several accounts: the only one is picked automatically, a second asks first; Keep other accounts in sync sends what you watch to all of them
• Simkl rebuilt with its new sign-in; MDBList now signs in with a code/QR (API key still works) and adds history, progress, watchlist, lists and IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic/Letterboxd ratings
• New: PunchPlay (history, progress, Continue Watching, watchlist, lists, collection)
• Add to list shows every account's watchlist and lists; Search finds your own lists and public Trakt/MDBList lists
• Each account's own rows can be added under Appearance › Rows
• TV: typing a key now opens the keyboard on OK, with the remote on the keyboard
